name: XLSX
quick_answer: XLSX — Microsoft Excel Open XML spreadsheet format for data analysis, formulas, pivot tables, charts, and collaborative workbook editing.
definition: XLSX is a spreadsheet file format. Microsoft Excel Open XML spreadsheet format for data analysis, formulas, pivot tables, charts, and collaborative workbook editing. It is commonly used in workflows that require reliable spreadsheet handling and is supported by a wide range of applications and online tools.

use_cases.title: Official document sharing
use_cases.text: XLSX is used to share documents that need to look the same on every device and operating system.

use_cases.title: Business reports and proposals
use_cases.text: XLSX is a reliable format for distributing professional reports, contracts, and formal documents.

use_cases.title: Form and template publishing
use_cases.text: XLSX is commonly used for fillable forms, legal documents, and templates with fixed structure.

use_cases.title: Archive and long-term storage
use_cases.text: XLSX is a trusted choice for archiving documents that need to remain readable over many years.

use_cases.title: Printing and publishing
use_cases.text: XLSX is used in print workflows because it preserves layout, fonts, and formatting across different printers.

advantages.title: Layout preservation
advantages.text: XLSX preserves fonts, formatting, and page layout across different operating systems and devices.

advantages.title: Universal compatibility
advantages.text: XLSX can be opened on virtually any device without requiring the authoring software.

advantages.title: Security features
advantages.text: XLSX can include password protection, permissions, and digital signatures for sensitive documents.

advantages.title: Print-ready output
advantages.text: XLSX is reliable for printing because it accurately represents the intended page design.

limitations.title: Limited editability
limitations.text: XLSX is not always easy to edit directly, especially for users without compatible software.

limitations.title: Complex formatting may not transfer
limitations.text: Converting from or to XLSX can sometimes lose custom styles, fonts, or layout elements.

limitations.title: Large file sizes
limitations.text: XLSX files with many embedded images or assets can be large and slow to load or send.

comparisons.title: XLSX vs XLS
comparisons.text: XLSX and XLS are both widely used file formats. Choosing between them depends on your compatibility needs, quality requirements, and the tools available in your workflow.

faq.question: What is a XLSX file?
faq.answer: A XLSX file is a spreadsheet format used for storing and sharing content.

faq.answer: You can open a XLSX file using compatible software for the spreadsheet category.
